purpose: Production fixed/adaptive Newmark comparison for a 300 s single-conductor model based on Duan Table 7, with explicitly reconstructed missing inputs; CR beam is a separate extended model.
execution: serial, same Release runtime, one execution thread, same output policy; static and dynamic timings separate

candidate_adaptive.parameter_basis: Existing conductor galloping settings; tighten only if comparison to fixed time refinement fails, report every configuration.

reference_fixed.kind: same-model time refinement, not analytical or independent solver reference

acceptance.galloping: Report vertical/horizontal/twist peak-to-peak envelopes in early/middle/late windows, nonzero cycles and growth/decay; do not equate static drift or successful integration to galloping. 300 s does not establish the paper 2000 s limit cycle.

restrictions: No fitting attack angle to produce growth
No numerical acceptance solely on a solver success flag
No cross-element equality claim: current CR beam lacks eccentric inertia/gravity terms and uses its current Rayleigh damping model
